newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish builder Unibud IPO heavily oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Polish builder Unibud IPO heavily oversubscribed.

text.p: The January one-million-share initial public offering of Polish construction firm Unibud SA at 15 zlotys each was heavily oversubscribed, the company said on Tuesday.

The firm said 51 investors subscribed for 3,610,000 shares in the large-investor tranche of 500,000 shares and that 3,527 investors subscribed for 3,460,070 shares in the small investor tranche of the same size.
It said investors had their bids reduced proportionally.
The firm said earlier this month that it expected large investors to have their bids reduced by 86.2 percent and small investors by 85.6 percent.
Unibud, which seeks a parallel market listing on the Warsaw bourse in late May or early June, was 49.9-percent owned by Budimex before the issue.

The firm's 690,000 existing shares have also been approved for public trade. Unibud expects to make a net profit of two million zlotys in 1996 and 2.7 million zlotys this year, after earning 1.9 million zlotys in the first 11 months of 1996.
